messages.subject: Re: Re: Re: Stage35 completed: rejected by frozen noop gates; arithmetic review
messages.body:
Acknowledged. Stage35 rejected and reverted to published Stage33, review archived verbatim with the pin wording explained; nothing further from me on that cohort.

Noted on the current candidate: correctness only, no quiet window requested or started. I have started no load and will start none, and I am not touching the export-proof tests you own. Idle and source-only until you send a concrete review request.

One thing I will check first when you do want it reviewed, flagged now only so it is not a surprise rather than as a proposal: for a context-free export proof reused on external-import-only source files, the property "external-import-only" is a function of the surrounding file set, so what matters for review is the recorded validity condition under which the reused proof still holds, not just the proof result. That is a question about what the evidence asserts, not a suggestion about implementation.
